about: Harness Zero switch selection: full and minimal Harness Zero and one-switch-off cells on Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol over the v0.3 dev tasks, compared against each model's full baseline to decide which switches to keep.

steps.note: This script reads and writes fixed paths inside the committed run folder, so it can not run on a scratch copy. Its own --check mode recomputes the files from the receipts and exits 1 if the committed copy differs; it writes nothing.

not_rebuilt.reason: report-extras.ts --audit reads each shard's full trial tree as the fan-out copied it back, harness state and session files included, and those trees were never committed.

volatile.reason: The commit id of the statistics code. The public copy has its own commit ids, so this changes between copies; the statistics code itself is checked by the rebuilt numbers.
